title: Membership in the one-step language
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input, let $x$ be a Boolean string, and let $c,c',s$ be natural numbers. The paired encoding of $x$, $c$, $c'$, and $s$ belongs to the one-step language of $N$ if and only if there are configurations $C,C'$ on input $x$ such that $C$ lies within window $s$ and has code $c$, $C'$ is obtained from $C$ by one step of $N$ and lies within window $s$, and $C'$ has code $c'$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine N with Boolean input
Natural numbers c, c', and s
